meta.title: SAP MDG (Master Data Governance): vendor created/updated in Procol
gaps: Configure the SAP MDG integration and its OAuth, endpoint, sync mode, batch size, and tenant gates.
Create or update a vendor in Procol with name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category.
Observe or verify the synchronization trigger and bidirectional exchange with SAP MDG/Oracle.
Compare the listed vendor master fields between Procol and the external system.
Verify that no integration error was recorded.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the SAP MDG integration and its OAuth, endpoint, sync mode, batch size, and tenant gates.; Create or update a vendor in Procol with name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category.; Observe or verify the synchronization trigger and bidirectional exchange with SAP MDG/Oracle.; Compare the listed vendor master fields between Procol and the external system.; Verify that no integration error was recorded.

args.need: configure the SAP MDG integration, create or update a vendor in Procol, compare all listed vendor master fields with the external Oracle system after synchronization, and verify that no integration error was recorded

steps.note: No catalog step can access integration settings, vendor master records, the external SAP MDG/Oracle system, or integration error logs.
Check that the current screen remains free of visible application errors after the tester completes the unavailable integration verification.
